h: Baby in Ecuador reportedly born with a full moustache
p: A newborn baby in Ecuador has gone viral after reportedly arriving with what looks like a full moustache. While most newborns are still struggling to open their eyes, this little one allegedly came out looking like he already has a wife, three children and bills to pay. Photos of the baby, wrapped in a towel with dark hair above his lip, have been shared widely online.
more: Social media users have been flooding the photos with jokes about the baby's "grown man" look.
Some newborns are born with extra fine body hair, which usually falls off within the first weeks of life.
The details of the birth have not been independently confirmed.
alt: A newborn baby with curly wet hair and dark hair above his upper lip, wrapped in a white towel
